nodes.name: Recipe Library API
nodes.notes: Public read-only endpoint for the recipe library and recipe details. Firebase credentials remain server-side.

nodes.name: Normalize Library Request
nodes.notes: Validates ID, cuisine, and page parameters before querying Firebase.

nodes.name: Library Request Valid?
nodes.notes: Checks whether ID, cuisine, and page parameters are valid before querying Firebase.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, error: { code: 'invalid_library_request', message: $('Normalize Library Request').item.json.errorMessage } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Invalid Library Request
nodes.notes: Returns a controlled HTTP 400 response for invalid library request parameters.

nodes.name: Read Recipes from Firebase
nodes.notes: Reads the protected Firebase recipe library using the server-side Google Service Account. No Firebase credentials are exposed to Angular.

nodes.name: Build Library Response
nodes.notes: Validates Firebase records, filters by cuisine, sorts newest first, and paginates server-side with 20 recipes per page.

nodes.name: Respond Library
nodes.notes: Returns validated recipe detail data or paginated library results to the Angular frontend.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { request_id: null, client_ip: null, status: 'failed', stage: 'firebase_library', error_code: 'firebase_read_failed', error_message: 'Firebase library read failed.', metadata: { id: $('Normalize Library Request').item.json.id, cuisine: $('Normalize Library Request').item.json.cuisine, page: $('Normalize Library Request').item.json.page } } }}

nodes.name: Log Firebase Library Error
nodes.notes: Writes an audit log for Firebase read failures without storing recipe data or secrets.

parameters.subject: Code-a-Cuisine: Firebase library error
parameters.text:
Die öffentliche Recipe-Library konnte Firebase nicht lesen.

Bitte n8n/Firebase-Ausführung kontrollieren.

nodes.name: Email Firebase Library Error
nodes.notes: Sends a technical notification when reading the Firebase recipe library fails.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, error: { code: 'firebase_read_failed', message: 'Die Rezeptebibliothek ist momentan nicht verfügbar.' } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Library Error
nodes.notes: Returns a controlled HTTP 502 response after a Firebase read failure.
